one_line: Finished results first in a steady top-down shot, product box in frame all the way, one reveal at the end.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a white table: hands press a stack of cards with a black rose print, a Giotto Olio Maxi box and open pastel tray behind. No speech, no text. 0:01 a card flips to a rose.
q1_hook.why: Finished, colourful prints in motion from frame one give a concrete reason to stay, with no intro (H1, E1). The box is in view from 0:00. But no line or text says what the viewer gets or how (H2), and nothing is said or written for a muted or sound-on viewer (H6).

beats.what: Hands flip through finished flower prints, pastel box and tray behind
beats.why: Results first, a new picture each second

beats.what: Hand opens the Giotto box, 12 pastels visible close up
beats.why: Names the tool the viewer would need

beats.what: Colouring the back of a tulip print with green and other pastels
beats.why: Step one; sped up so it stays short

beats.what: White sheet laid on top and clipped
Tracing the tulip with a sharp pencil, then lifting the top sheet
beats.why: The core method; lines visibly build up

beats.what: A second design, a rose: traced, shown and peeled apart in three short shots
beats.why: Repeats the method on a new picture

beats.what: Multicolour rose held flat in the last shot, video ends
beats.why: Answers how the opening prints were made

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: an offer to send printable sheets of leaves and animals to anyone who comments ("תגיבו על הריל"). Nothing in the video asks for a comment, share or save.
q2_flow.why: The opening results raise "how?" and the rose reveal at 0:26 answers it (H5, R4). The sped-up colouring and shot changes keep the first 12 s moving (R3, E3). The 0:13 to 0:23 tracing is the longest single stretch, held by visible progress only (R1). Short length suits one craft (R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, mid-text: "אני יכולה לשלוח למי שרוצה, תגיבו על הריל ❤️", for extra sheets of leaves and animals. No comment word, no link.
q3_cta.why: The ask has a real purpose: a free printable in return for a comment (C2, R6). It is one ask only (C1). But it appears only in the caption, never said or shown in the video, and no keyword is named, so delivery is manual (C6, C3).

q4_shown.what: Finished prints 0:00 to 0:05; the open box and 12 pastels 0:05 to 0:07; hands colouring, clipping and tracing in order; box and tray in frame in most shots; rose reveal at 0:27. No price, no face. Hands in the last seconds look smaller.
q4_shown.why: The product is on screen at 0:00 and used on screen throughout (S1, K5). Hands only carry the whole Reel with no face (S4). The result, shown before and after the method, is the proof. The box stays visible all the way, a repeated pulse of brand inside the action (H3).

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 27.7 s, about 3 s; straight cuts, no transitions. Longest shot about 11 s (0:12 to 0:23). Colouring sped up (a tulip goes from a few strokes to full colour in about 2 s). No text, no speech. Ends on the reveal.
q5_edit.why: A cut or movement in the first second and steady changes after it fit the moderate pace (E1, E2). Speed-up is on hands and an object, as advised (E3). It ends on the payoff, no dead tail (E8). With no speech or text, a muted viewer gets no message (E4).

q6_topic.what: A flower transfer drawing craft with oil pastels, paper clips and a pencil; serves a parent looking for a calm, screen-free activity with a free printable.
q6_topic.why: A doable activity a parent can copy and a free sheet to ask for gives a reason to save or send (R5, R7). The caption claim (pencil grip and force control) is modest and checkable (K4). The feeling is calm and satisfying, with one reveal, not a high-arousal peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone looking straight down at a white table in bright daylight; hands only, no face; the box and tray sit upper left. Close-up of the box 0:05 to 0:07, wide table shots otherwise. Angle and zoom shift slightly between shots.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5). Full-frame vertical video, all live motion (F1, F8). Sharp and evenly lit but still homemade (F7). The pastels fill the frame only in the 0:05 close-up; in wide shots the box and pastel labels are small (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: None. No headline card, no step labels, no subtitles, no CTA text, no logo overlay. The only words are on the product box itself ("GIOTTO OLIO MAXI").
q8_text.caption: "טרנספר פרחים 🌹🌷🪻🌻". About 100 words: the steps written out, a benefit line (pencil grip, force control), a comment-for-sheets offer, 5 hashtags (#screenfreeactivities #kidcrafts #פעילותלילדים #טרנספר #יצירהלילדים), the partner line "בשיתוף @giotto_israel" last.
q8_text.why: Without text or voice, the method is readable only in the caption, so a muted viewer cannot follow the steps (T1, T3). The first line is a plain Hebrew keyword title, good for search, and hashtags stay at five (T7). The partner line is last, below the fold, with no paid label (T8, S7).

weak_points: No voice or on-screen text, so steps and the offer exist only in the caption; partner disclosure at the very end of a long caption; the only call to action is not shown in the video.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone above a white table: flip through finished pages first, then open the book and turn pages with hands only, ending on one reveal.
not_verified: The music (transcript is only "תודה רבה", no speech evident). Whether the smaller hands in the last 5 s are a child's. Whether the phone is propped or hand-held (angle shifts slightly between shots). Correction to coded file: 9 shots confirmed from index cuts, the rose section is four short shots (0:23 to 0:28), not one. The caption also names a child, which is not repeated here.
